events.title: Austin Peay vs. Evansville
events.blurb: Austin Peay Governors women's basketball hosts Evansville at 2 p.m. Saturday on Gary Mathews Court, part of a four-game homestand.
events.blurbEs: El equipo femenino de baloncesto de los Austin Peay Governors recibe a Evansville el sábado a las 2 p.m. en Gary Mathews Court, como parte de una serie de cuatro partidos en casa.

events.title: Christmas on the Cumberland
events.blurb: More than a million holiday lights line McGregor Park and the Cumberland RiverWalk downtown. It's a free evening stroll for families or a date.
events.blurbEs: Más de un millón de luces navideñas adornan McGregor Park y el Cumberland RiverWalk en el centro. Es un paseo nocturno gratis, ideal en familia o en pareja.

events.title: Customs House Museum
events.blurb: Downtown's art and history museum, with current shows including The Chestnut Group's 25th anniversary exhibition and Toys from the Collection. Kids get in for $5, and children 2 and under are free.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte e historia del centro, con exposiciones actuales como la muestra del 25.º aniversario de The Chestnut Group y Toys from the Collection. Los niños pagan $5 y los menores de 2 años entran gratis.
events.getThere: Free parking in the lot directly behind the museum on South Second Street.

events.title: Drive Thru Christmas Lights
events.blurb: Drive the one-mile speedway track past millions of holiday lights, as many laps as you like, without leaving your car.
events.blurbEs: Recorre en tu auto la pista de una milla del autódromo entre millones de luces navideñas, todas las vueltas que quieras.
